title: Parked out front
logline: The Legacy parked in the tavern's front lot for the first time in the book, April 2025, under the sign, the sign's name cut off by the page's top edge. Six weeks before the front door. The car goes first.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon parked in a tavern's gravel front lot beneath a sign cut off by the page's top edge, the tavern's door shut, afternoon.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon parked in a tavern's gravel front lot beneath a sign cut off by the page's top edge, the door shut, afternoon light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
